title: RISE: Rule-Driven SQL Dialect Translation via Query Reduction
summary: The original RISE pipeline translates SQL across dialects with a rule-driven, query-reduction workflow, and reports a SingleLLM/LLMTranslator baseline alongside it.
This reproduction is that single-LLM baseline: one prompt translates a source PostgreSQL query to MySQL, scored as the paper scores it by executing both queries and comparing result sets.
